title: Marketing Strategy Creator
description: Develop a complete marketing strategy for a product, service, or brand.
prompt: Act as an experienced marketing strategist. Create a comprehensive marketing strategy for [PRODUCT / SERVICE / BRAND]. Include target audience, positioning, key channels, content plan, budget allocation suggestions, and KPIs. Make it realistic and actionable.

title: Social Media Marketing Expert
description: Plan effective social media campaigns and content strategies for different platforms.
prompt: Act as a social media marketing expert. Create a 30-day social media content and campaign plan for [BRAND OR PRODUCT] on [PLATFORMS]. Include post ideas, content pillars, posting frequency, hashtag strategy, and engagement tactics.

title: Ad Copywriter
description: Write high-converting ad copies for Google, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms.
prompt: Act as a performance marketing copywriter. Write 5 high-converting ad variations for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE] targeting [AUDIENCE]. Create versions for [PLATFORM] (e.g., Facebook Ads, Google Ads, TikTok). Include headlines, primary text, and call-to-action.

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description: Design effective email marketing sequences and campaigns.
prompt: Act as an email marketing specialist. Create a complete email sequence for [PURPOSE] (e.g., welcome series, abandoned cart, product launch). Write subject lines, preview texts, and full email bodies for [NUMBER] emails. Focus on high open and click rates.

title: Content Marketing Planner
description: Build content marketing strategies that attract and convert the target audience.
prompt: Act as a content marketing strategist. Develop a content marketing plan for [BRAND OR NICHE]. Define content pillars, formats, distribution channels, SEO opportunities, and a 3-month content calendar outline.

title: Branding Advisor
description: Help define or improve brand identity, voice, and positioning.
prompt: Act as a branding expert. Help develop or refine the brand identity for [BRAND OR BUSINESS]. Define brand positioning, unique value proposition, brand voice, personality, and messaging guidelines.

title: Customer Journey Mapper
description: Map the full customer journey and identify marketing opportunities at each stage.
prompt: Act as a customer experience and marketing specialist. Map the complete customer journey for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE]. Identify stages from awareness to loyalty, key touchpoints, pain points, and marketing actions for each stage.

title: Influencer Marketing Strategist
description: Create effective influencer marketing campaigns and collaboration strategies.
prompt: Act as an influencer marketing expert. Design an influencer marketing strategy for [BRAND OR PRODUCT]. Suggest influencer types, collaboration formats, outreach approach, campaign goals, and success metrics.

title: Marketing Funnel Builder
description: Design marketing funnels that guide prospects from awareness to conversion.
prompt: Act as a funnel marketing expert. Build a complete marketing funnel for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE]. Define each stage (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU), recommended content and offers, traffic sources, and conversion optimization ideas.

title: Competitor Marketing Analyzer
description: Analyze competitors’ marketing strategies and find opportunities to outperform them.
prompt: Act as a competitive marketing analyst. Analyze the marketing strategies of [COMPETITOR BRANDS] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Compare their channels, messaging, content, ads, and strengths/weaknesses. Suggest ways for [YOUR BRAND] to differentiate and win.
